Wait — reconsider whether "(1)" is a footnote. In the original OIML certificate format for R51 under scheme A, the accuracy class line often reads "XIII(1)" with footnote. Actually for R51 the classes are XI, XII, XIII. Hmm, but actually I recall catchweigher accuracy classes per R51:2006 are XI, XII, XIII. The "(1)" footnote "the actual accuracy class is determined at the time of putting into use" is standard for class XIII instruments ("class XIII" catchweighers where actual class assigned at verification... actually the note makes sense). I'll treat it as footnote.
